player_prompt.intro:
Yin aci Player {player_id} kɛn HighSociety (2-player version).
Kuɛ̈ɛ̈t:  Thiär kɛn kuɛ̈ɛ̈t 10 kɛn kuɛ̈ɛ̈t.
Lɛ̈k:    Kuɛ̈ɛ̈t kɛn, lɛ̈k wɛ̈tde kɛn 1-11 rɛ̈ŋ.
            • Lɛ̈k kɛn wɛ̈l thiär kɛn rɛ̈ŋ wɛ̈tde.
            • Lɛ̈k de wɛ̈l wɛ̈tde kɛn.
            • Tie -> lɛ̈k kɛn rɛ̈ŋ wɛ̈tde kɛn kuɛ̈ɛ̈t.
Cɛ̈kɛ̈n:    Kuɛ̈ɛ̈t kɛn, wɛ̈tde + cɛ̈kɛ̈n thiär.
            Wɛ̈tde kɛn wɛ̈l (tie -> kuɛ̈ɛ̈t).

**Lɛ̈k syntax**  →  lɛ̈k wɛ̈tde kɛn rɛ̈ŋ '[7]' or '[11]'.
